story.titleZh: FIA确定迈凯伦与红牛摩纳哥大奖赛上诉听证日期
story.summaryZh: 国际汽联（FIA）将于下周审理迈凯伦和红牛针对摩纳哥大奖赛恢复皮埃尔·加斯利领奖台位置决定的上诉。
story.originalTitle: FIA sets date for McLaren and Red Bull's Monaco GP appeal
story.summaryEn: The FIA will hear McLaren and Red Bull's appeals next week regarding the decision to restore Pierre Gasly's podium position from the Monaco Grand Prix.
detailZh: FIA确定迈凯伦和红牛就摩纳哥大奖赛上诉的听证日期
两支车队对6月恢复皮埃尔·加斯利摩纳哥领奖台成绩的决定提出上诉
兰多·诺里斯，迈凯伦，皮埃尔·加斯利，阿尔派车队
下周，FIA将听取迈凯伦和红牛针对恢复皮埃尔·加斯利在摩纳哥大奖赛领奖台成绩的决定所提出的上诉。
6月7日，这位阿尔派车手冲线时名列第三，但因两次维修区超速各被罚时五秒，愤怒的Gasly被降至第七名，从而使红牛车队的哈贾尔登上了领奖台。
但这家法国车队立即提出了复审申请，因为有证据表明这位30岁的车手并未超过60公里/小时的限速，甚至还额外留出了余量以保持低于限速。
在复审听证会上，FOM——F1的计时方——承认维修区内用于测速的距离测量存在误差。
这导致平均速度被高报，因此干事们接受该误差作为证据，认定Gasly的处罚应被撤销，从而恢复他的第三名成绩。
因此，这位法国车手最终拿到了他职业生涯的第六个领奖台，但这在各车队中引发了愤怒，因为因为据称在维修通道超速而被处罚的并不只有加斯利一人。
安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯；刘易斯·汉密尔顿，法拉利；伊萨克·哈贾尔，红牛车队；托托·沃尔夫，梅赛德斯
唯一的区别是，其他车手已经在比赛中执行完了他们的处罚，这令各车队难以置信：阿尔派 的抗议竟然成功了。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里持有尤为强烈的意见，因为这位迈凯伦车手额外多进了一次站来执行处罚，导致他最终以第五名越过终点线，排在加斯利和哈贾尔之后。
“这个决定让我相当难以置信，”皮亚斯特里在巴塞罗那比赛后说道。
“当其他车手因为同样的事情受罚并在比赛中执行了处罚时，你却还能更改一项处罚，而且明知这已经影响到了至少五六场比赛，这实在令人震惊。”"
乔治·拉塞尔可以说是最受委屈的一位，这位梅赛德斯车手在进站后本有望登上领奖台——结果干事却认定他没有正确执行处罚。
这导致他被处以一次通过维修区的处罚，从积分榜前十跌至第12名，使他落后于领跑车手总冠军的队友基米·安东内利68分。
皮亚斯特里，迈凯伦；哈贾尔，红牛车队
“我显然丢掉了这个位置，但我只能想象George现在的感受，”Piastri补充道，“我简直不敢相信自己的眼睛。”
“我把位置丢给了Pierre，因为我接受了处罚。从技术上讲我应该是第三名，但从技术上讲George也应该是第三名。”
“整件事现在一团糟。他们给自己树立了一个相当离谱的先例。”
因此，这促使迈凯伦和红牛对这一决定提出上诉，而梅赛德斯则启动了复审权，但随后撤回了该申请，因为拉塞尔的成绩被推翻的可能性很小。
数周以来，相关诉讼的消息一直沉寂，但国际汽联（FIA）现已确认，其国际上诉法院将于8月25日星期二听取迈凯伦和红牛的陈述。
听证会将在本周末的荷兰大奖赛之后，于巴黎的国际汽联总部闭门举行，这是自2026年夏季休赛期以来的首场比赛。
detailEn: FIA sets date for McLaren and Red Bull's Monaco GP appeal
The two teams have appealed against the decision to reinstate Pierre Gasly's Monaco podium from June
Lando Norris, McLaren, Pierre Gasly, Alpine
Next week, the FIA will hear the appeals from McLaren and Red Bull against the decision to reinstate Pierre Gasly’s podium at the Monaco Grand Prix.
The Alpine driver crossed the line in third on 7 June but two five-second penalties for pitlane speeding demoted a furious Gasly to seventh, handing Red Bull’s Isack Hadjar a podium.
But the French outfit immediately lodged a right of review bid because it had evidence that the 30-year-old had not exceeded the 60km/h limit and even took additional margin to stay below.
During the right of review hearing FOM - F1’s timekeeper - admitted that there had been an error with the distance measurement in the pitlane from which speeds were taken.
This caused average speeds to be over-reported and so stewards accepted the error as evidence that Gasly should have his penalties rescinded and thus, his third-place reinstated.
As such, the Frenchman finally secured his sixth career podium but this caused fury among teams, because Gasly wasn’t the only driver to be penalised for supposedly speeding in the pitlane.
Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes, Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari, Isack Hadjar, Red Bull Racing, Toto Wolff, Mercedes
The only difference was that other drivers had already served their penalties during the race, causing disbelief among teams that Alpine had been successful with its protest.
Oscar Piastri held a particularly strong opinion as the McLaren driver made an extra pitstop to serve his penalty, causing him to cross the finish line in fifth behind Gasly and Hadjar.
“I’m pretty mind-blown by the decision,” said Piastri at the following the Barcelona race.

“When other people have been penalised for the same thing and served a penalty in the race, how you can then change one penalty, knowing that at least five or six other races have been impacted by that, is astonishing.”
George Russell was arguably the hardest done by as the Mercedes driver lost a potential podium when he pitted - only for stewards to determine he hadn’t served the penalty correctly.
This resulted in a drive-through penalty that dropped the title contender out of the top 10 into 12th, causing him to fall 68 points behind his championship-leading team-mate Kimi Antonelli.
Oscar Piastri, McLaren, Isack Hadjar, Red Bull Racing
“I’ve obviously lost the position, but I can only imagine how George is feeling,” added Piastri. “I could not believe my eyes.
“I lost the position to Pierre because I served the penalty. Technically I should be P3, but then technically George should be P3.
“The whole thing is now a mess. It’s quite the precedent they’ve got themselves into.”

It therefore caused McLaren and Red Bull to appeal the decision, while Mercedes launched a right to review but subsequently withdrew that as it had little chance of getting Russell’s result overturned.
For weeks, news of the proceedings had gone quiet but the FIA has now confirmed that its International Court of Appeal will hear from McLaren and Red Bull on Tuesday 25 August.
This will take place behind closed doors at the FIA’s headquarters in Paris after this weekend’s Dutch Grand Prix, the first race since the 2026 summer shutdown.

relatedItems.originalTitle: Ralf Schumacher slams Colton Herta's F1 prospects: "He's just burning fuel"
detailZh: 拉尔夫·舒马赫抨击科尔顿·赫塔的F1前景："他只是在燃烧燃料"
拉尔夫·舒马赫对科尔顿·赫塔的F1前景给出了严厉的评价，质疑了这位美国人在F2的表现，并否认了他获得凯迪拉克赛车座位的可能性
表面上，科尔顿·赫塔在Interlagos的周五似乎已经取得了难以想象的好成绩。这位凯迪拉克测试车手取代了塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯，参加了2026年圣保罗大奖赛的第一场练习，完成了24圈，并获得了他获得FIA超级执照所需的最后一点积分。从纸面上看，这位美国人现在有资格在2027年参加F1比赛。
然而，前F1车手兼评论员拉尔夫·舒马赫对此并不认同。当被问及赫塔是否可能是佩雷斯旁边的第二位凯迪拉克车手候选人时，天空德国的评论员回答说："只有当复活节和圣诞节在同一天的时候。说真的，这是没有意义的。他只是在燃烧燃料，借用弗朗茨·托斯特的一句话。我甚至不知道这有什么意义。你不如让其他人开车，给一些年轻车手一个机会。"
舒马赫特别批评了赫塔的F2赛季：“他在F2中真的很糟糕。在我看来，他根本不配。我认为他们尝试推广美国车手是很好的。但这也必须有意义，他根本不适合F1。”
与其让赫塔参赛，舒马赫更愿意看到年轻车手得到机会。他以麦克拉伦青训车队的莱昂纳多·福纳罗利为例，他在F2和F3中都赢得了冠军，称他为“一个极其出色的车手”。然而，除此之外，为佩雷斯找到合适的搭档将会“非常、非常困难”。
赫塔转战F2是为了证明自己配得上F1的席位并积累超级驾照积分。但他在锦标赛中目前排名第19，积26分，至今未能赢得一场胜利或登上领奖台。甚至F2首席执行官布鲁诺·米歇尔也承认，赫塔的表现比预期更差。
因此，赫塔通过一条替代途径获得了超级驾照。除了在印第安纳波利斯赛车赛（IndyCar）中赢得的积分，在那里他赢得了九场比赛并获得了2024年锦标赛的亚军，他还通过为凯迪拉克的周五练习赛出场获得了额外的积分。
凯迪拉克的2027赛季已经确认了一位车手：佩雷斯在10月底将合同延长至2029年。然而，瓦尔特里·博塔斯是否会继续留在车队，目前还不明确。除了赫塔之外，还有其他一些名字被提及，例如乔治·拉塞尔，他提出了梅赛德斯车手弗雷德里克·维斯蒂作为候选人。
在周五在英特拉戈斯赛道进行的练习赛中，赫塔比博塔斯慢了大约九十分之一秒。
detailEn: Ralf Schumacher slams Colton Herta's F1 prospects: "He's just burning fuel"

Ralf Schumacher has delivered a scathing assessment of Colton Herta's Formula 1 prospects, questioning the American's performances in Formula 2 and dismissing his chances of securing a Cadillac race seat

On the face of it, Friday at Interlagos could hardly have gone any better for Colton Herta. The Cadillac test driver replaced Sergio Perez in first practice for the 2026 Sao Paulo Grand Prix, completed 24 laps and secured the final point he needed for his FIA super licence. On paper, the American is now eligible to race in Formula 1 in 2027.

Former F1 driver turned pundit Ralf Schumacher, however, is having none of it. Asked whether Herta could be a candidate for the second Cadillac seat alongside Perez, the Sky Germany pundit replied: "Only if Easter and Christmas fall on the same day. Seriously, it's pointless. He's just burning fuel, to borrow a phrase from Franz Tost. I don't even know what the point of it is. You might as well put someone else in the car, give some young drivers a chance."

Schumacher was particularly critical of Herta's Formula 2 campaign: "He was really that bad in Formula 2. As far as I'm concerned, he hasn't earned it at all. I think it's great that they're trying to promote American drivers. But it has to make sense, and he has no place in Formula 1."

Instead of Herta, Schumacher would prefer to see young drivers given an opportunity. As an example, he points to McLaren junior Leonardo Fornaroli, who has won championships in both Formula 2 and Formula 3, describing him as "an incredibly strong driver". Otherwise, however, finding the right partner for Perez would be "very, very difficult".

Herta had moved to Formula 2 to prove himself worthy of a Formula 1 seat and accumulate super licence points. But he currently sits just 19th in the championship standings with 26 points, having failed to claim a victory or even a podium finish so far. Even Formula 2 CEO Bruno Michel admits that Herta has struggled more than expected.

The American therefore secured his super licence through an alternative route. In addition to the points he earned in IndyCar, where he won nine races and finished runner-up in the 2024 championship, he collected further points through his Friday practice appearances for Cadillac.

One of Cadillac's 2027 seats is already confirmed: Perez extended his contract until 2029 at the end of October. Whether Valtteri Bottas will remain with the team, however, is still unclear. Several other names have been mentioned alongside Herta, with George Russell, for example, putting Mercedes talent Frederik Vesti forward as a candidate.
In their head-to-head comparison during Friday's practice session at Interlagos, Herta was around nine tenths of a second slower than Bottas.
keyPointsZh: 赫塔现在符合2027年F1参赛资格。
keyPointsEn: Colton Herta is now eligible to race in Formula 1 in 2027.

detailZh: 法拉利在直线道上速度慢，在弯道中挣扎：查尔斯·勒克莱尔表示这是‘最糟糕的感觉之一’
勒克莱尔对巴西大奖赛周五的复杂情况作出反应
查尔斯·勒克莱尔在巴西大奖赛的周五练习后，描述了他的法拉利SF-26在直线道上速度慢，在弯道中感觉非常糟糕
刘易斯·汉密尔顿和勒克莱尔在第二次自由练习中分别排在第六和第七，分别比银箭车队的领跑者基米·安东内利慢0.45秒和0.72秒，这与斯库德里亚典型的周五速度相比很不寻常。
“今天周五非常、非常困难，”勒克莱尔说，他在FP1中将自己的赛车交给了法拉利的弟子迪诺·贝加诺维奇，在FP2中被法拉利学院的毕业生拉斐尔·卡马拉阻碍了。
“车内的感觉非常糟糕，所以我们有很多工作要做——可能比其他周末还要多——从今天到明天要改变很多东西。感觉真的很奇怪。有很多事情需要改变。
“我们肯定在直道上失去了优势，但车在弯道上的感觉可能是本赛季最糟糕的周五之一。所以我们需要在弯道中找到很多改进空间，比在直道上的改进空间更大，因为我们知道在直道上我们存在劣势。但通常我们在弯道上的速度非常快，而今天并不是这样。”
当被问及是否通过调整设置可以让SF-26回到正确的窗口，或者法拉利是否面临一个出乎意料的艰难周末时，勒克莱尔回答道：“嗯，我还没有答案。我对要改变什么有很多想法，我认为明天会有重大的变化。
“是否足够……今天我们遇到的问题相当大，但没有任何理由说明我们会在这样的赛道上遇到更多的麻烦。所以我们需要找到解决方案。”
车队负责人弗雷德·瓦瑟尔承认存在“几个问题”和“大量的工作”在前面，但他比勒克莱尔对法拉利在本周末剩余时间的胜算更为乐观。
“还有很多平衡工作要做，”这位法国人说。“车手们并不开心。查尔斯今天早上没有参加FP1。我们今天遇到了一些问题，明天还有很多工作要做。最重要的是，明天的天气预报和周日一般般，这意味着我们必须准备好应对所有条件。但我并不比上周更悲观。”
当被问及勒克莱尔关于潜在引擎问题的无线电信息时，瓦瑟尔澄清说：“我们在几圈中遇到了部署问题。我们必须对一切进行微调。在他的最快圈速中，他在直道上失去了几十分之一秒。”
“我认为这并不是一场戏剧，而是你需要专注于时间表的第一页[的排名]，但我们并没有。我们知道我们在平衡方面还有很多工作要做。平衡并不好，并不出色。路面与一周前相反。它创造了很多工作要做，与上周相比有很大的不同。”
然而，围绕法拉利的主题主要是关于墨西哥大奖赛第一圈车手之间的最新冲突，这可能让他们失去了胜利的机会。
周四晚上举行了一次会议来澄清事情，但当被问及此事时，勒克莱尔避而不谈。
“聚在一起讨论真的很不错，”这位摩纳哥人说。“显然，对我来说，这已经是一周疯狂的经历，而且是积极的，因为我第一次成为父亲，所以我们没有必要讨论。”
“讨论总是关于剩下的事情或者剩下的挫折，这是必要的。现在我感觉已经完全解决了，我认为我们不应该过多地谈论它了。”
detailEn: Ferrari slow on straights, struggling in corners: ‘One of the worst feelings’ for Charles Leclerc
Leclerc reacts to a tricky Friday for Ferrari in Brazil
Charles Leclerc has described his Ferrari SF-26 as slow on straights with a terrible feeling in corners following Friday practice at Formula 1’s Brazilian Grand Prix.

Lewis Hamilton and Leclerc were sixth- and seventh-fastest in Free Practice 2, respectively 0.45s and 0.72s slower than pacesetter Kimi Antonelli in his Silver Arrow, which is unusual compared to the Scuderia’s typical Friday pace.
“It's been a very, very difficult Friday,” said Leclerc, who ceded his car to Ferrari protege Dino Beganovic in FP1 and was impeded by Ferrari academy graduate Rafael Camara in FP2.

“The feeling was just very poor inside the car, so we've got a lot of work to do – and probably more than other weekends – to change quite a lot the car from today to tomorrow. It just felt quite strange, in a way. Lots of changes to be made.

“We were losing for sure in the straights, but the car in the corners just felt probably one of the worst Friday feelings of the season. So there's a lot to be found in corners, more than in the straights, where we know we have a deficit. But normally we are very fast in corners and today it was not the case.”

Asked whether set-up tweaks could get the SF-26 back into the right window or if Ferrari was in for an unexpectedly difficult weekend, Leclerc responded: “Well, I don't have the answer yet. I've got quite a lot of ideas on what to change and I think there will be significant changes going into tomorrow.
“Whether that will be enough… the issues we had today were quite big, but there's no reason why we will struggle so much more on a track like this. So we need to find a solution.”
Team principal Fred Vasseur admitted to “a couple of issues” and “a lot of work” ahead, but was more optimistic than Leclerc as to Ferrari’s chances in the remainder of the weekend.

“A lot to do on the balance,” the Frenchman said. “Drivers, they were not happy. Charles didn't do FP1 this morning. We had a couple of issues today and a lot of work to prepare tomorrow. On the top, the weather forecast tomorrow and Sunday is so-so, it means that we have to be prepared to all the conditions. But I'm not less optimistic than last week.”

Questioned about Leclerc’s radio messages regarding potential engine trouble, Vasseur clarified: “A couple of times we had a deployment issue in the laps. We have to fine-tune everything. On his fastest lap, he lost a couple of tenths in a straight line.

“I would say that it's not a drama, it's more for you to be focused on page one [of the timesheet], but we are not. We know that we have a lot to do on the balance. The balance was not good, not great. The tarmac is the opposite of one week ago. It's creating a lot of work to do and a difference compared to last week.”
The main topic surrounding Ferrari, however, has been the drivers’ latest clash on lap one of the Mexican Grand Prix, which may have cost them victory.
A meeting took place on Thursday evening to set things straight, but when asked about it, Leclerc was elusive.

“It was really good to just discuss all together,” the Monegasque said. “Obviously, for me, it's been a bit of a crazy week and positively because I became a father for the first time, so we didn't necessarily have time to discuss.
“Discussing always is whatever is left or whatever frustration is left, and that was needed. Now I feel it's fully settled and I don't think we should be speaking about it too much going forward.”
keyPointsZh: 勒克莱尔认为这是他遇到的最糟糕的感觉之一。
keyPointsEn: Leclerc described it as one of the worst feelings he has encountered.

detailZh: 小红牛领队“理解外界对车手决定延迟的不满”
小红牛领队艾伦·珀曼在巴西因车队迟迟未决定2027年F1车手阵容而受到关注
小红牛领队艾伦·珀曼表示，他“理解外界的不满”，因为车队迟迟未决定2027年是否留用利亚姆·劳森，还是提拔储备车手、F2前列车手尼古拉·措洛夫。
这支红牛卫星车队本赛季由劳森和新秀队友阿维德·林德布拉德出战，有望在车队积分榜上取得前所未有的第五名，这将是他队史上最成功的一个赛季。
随着劳森找回了迄今为止的最佳状态，而少年林德布拉德也展现出巨大潜力，车队通常会被期望在2027年保留两位车手。但作为未来红牛车队车手的培养基地，这一角色正在改变这种动态，因为劳森已不在米尔顿凯恩斯车队的长期规划中。而在保加利亚人措洛夫身上，车队拥有一名令人兴奋的年轻天才，他有可能与林德布拉德竞争未来主力车队的一个席位。
然而，红牛母公司也期望小红牛车队能够自立自强并具备竞争力，正如本赛季所成功展示的那样。
在短期表现、稳定性和劳森的经验与措洛夫未来对红牛的上行潜力之间做出痛苦抉择，正是为何原本预计更早到来的决定现在看起来至少要拖到拉斯维加斯。
与此同时，这支英意车队的社交媒体账号被要求为劳森续签2027年合同的车迷们刷屏。周四，阿尔维德·林德布拉德的频道发布了一条帖子，庆祝在墨西哥第一节练习赛中与儿时好友措洛夫在F1重逢，这引发了困惑，因为一些车迷将其视为车队2027年阵容的意外确认。
缺乏明确性也让劳森感到压力，他承认自己“不知道他们还想让我做什么”。
周五在巴西发表讲话时，车队老板艾伦·珀曼表示，他理解缺乏决定让外界感到沮丧。但他坚持认为，车队正在尽职尽责地敲定选择。珀曼已签下一份新合同，将继续担任小红牛车队领队兼联合首席执行官，直至2031年。
“我们试图运用一点科学方法，这需要一些时间，”珀曼解释道。“我们正在审视一切，研究、分析，而时间站在我们这边。我们不急于做任何事，我非常有信心会做出正确的决定。
“我意识到这对我们的车手来说很令人沮丧。我意识到这对其他人来说也很令人沮丧，但我们想把它做对，而且我们会做对。我相信当我们在未来几周宣布时，每个人都会高兴。我们几乎就要完成了，但还没有最终敲定。”
不过，决定留下劳森并不一定违背车队培养年轻人才的原则。除了劳森贡献的大量积分之外，让这位经验更丰富的新西兰人驾驶另一辆赛车，也为车队提供了一个有用的基准工具，用来评判林德布拉德在新秀赛季的进步。
在解释车队看似相互冲突的目标时，佩尔曼表示：“主要因素一如既往，是速度和 pace。这是我们最先看重的。”
“但我们不仅仅是一支只为参赛而存在的车队。我们在这里是为了培养年轻人才，所以我们必须关注这一点。而这并不一定意味着我们只是不断地让年轻人才轮流驾驶赛车。我们可能需要一些经验，来衡量这些人才。”
“所以，这不是一个容易的决定，我理解并感受到所有人的沮丧。我感受到我的车手们的沮丧。但我们正在取得进展，不会太久了。”
detailEn: Racing Bulls boss ‘understands frustration’ over driver decision delay
Racing Bulls team principal Alan Permane faced scrutiny in Brazil over the team's delay in deciding its 2027 Formula 1 driver line-up

Racing Bulls boss Alan Permane says he "understands the frustration" over the delay in his team's decision on whether to retain Liam Lawson or promote reserve driver and F2 frontrunner Nikola Tsolov for 2027.

Red Bull's satellite team is set for its most successful season in its history with Lawson and rookie team-mate Arvid Lindblad as it heads towards an unprecedented fifth place in the constructors' standings.

With Lawson having found his best form to date and teenager Lindblad showing plenty of promise, the team would normally be expected to retain both drivers for 2027. But its role as a breeding ground for future Red Bull Racing drivers is changing that dynamic, as Lawson is no longer in the Milton Keynes team's long-term picture. And in Bulgarian Tsolov, it has an exciting young talent in the ranks that could potentially vie with Lindblad for a future spot on the main team.
Yet Racing Bulls is also expected by Red Bull's parent company to be standing on its own feet and be competitive, as it has successfully demonstrated this season.

That agonising decision between short-term performance, stability and experience in Lawson and future Red Bull upside in Tsolov is why a decision that had been expected to arrive earlier now looks set to drag on until at least Las Vegas.

Meanwhile, the Anglo-Italian team's social media accounts have been flooded by fans demanding Lawson be re-signed for 2027. A post on Arvid Lindblad's channels on Thursday, in which he celebrated being reunited with childhood friend Tsolov in F1 as they took part in Mexico's FP1 session, caused confusion as some fans took it as accidental confirmation of the team's 2027 line-up.
The lack of clarity has also been weighing on Lawson, who admitted that he doesn't ‘know what else they want me to do’.

Speaking in Brazil on Friday, team boss Alan Permane, who has inked a fresh deal until 2031 as Racing Bulls team principal and co-CEO, said he understood why the lack of decision was frustrating to the outside world. But he insisted the team is doing its due diligence to nail its choice.

"We're trying to apply a little bit of science, and that takes some time," Permane explained. "We are looking at everything and studying, analysing, and time is on our side. We're not in a rush to do anything, and I'm very confident the right decision will be made.

"I realise it's frustrating for our drivers. I realise it's frustrating for everyone else, but we want to get it right, and we will get it right. I'm sure when we announce it in the coming weeks, everyone will be happy. We're almost there, but we're not finalised."

A decision to retain Lawson doesn't have to go against the squad's mantra of bringing up young talent, though. Aside from the large number of points Lawson has contributed, having the more experienced New Zealander in the other car has been a useful benchmarking tool for the team to judge Lindblad's progress in his rookie campaign.
Explaining the team's seemingly conflicting objectives, Permane said: "The main factors are, as always, pace and speed. That's the very first thing we look for.

"But we're not just a team that exists solely to compete. We are here to bring young talent through, so we have to keep an eye on that. And that doesn't necessarily mean that we just keep churning young talent through the car. We need to maybe have some experience as well to measure that talent.
"So, it's not an easy decision, and I understand and get the frustration from everyone. I get the frustration from my drivers. But we're getting there, and it won't be long."
